definitions.gloss: as one; united; coming together as a unified body
definitions.explanation: An expression describing a group of people uniting as a single body to work toward a common goal. Emphasizes solidarity, teamwork, and collective effort.

examples.japanese: ⟦チーム→チーム：03858_chiimu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{一丸|いちがん}となって⟦{戦|たたか}った→戦う：02071_tatakau⟧。
⟦{社員|しゃいん}→社員：03065_shain⟧⟦{全員|ぜんいん}→全員：03310_zenin⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{一丸|いちがん}となって⟦{目標|もくひょう}→目標：03631_mokuhyou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{取|と}り{組|く}んだ→取り組む：04225_torikumu⟧。
examples.english: All employees united and worked toward the goal.

examples.japanese: ⟦{被災地|ひさいち}→被災地：27434_hisaichi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{復興|ふっこう}→復興：07590_fukkou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{向|む}けて→向ける：02306_mukeru⟧、⟦{地域|ちいき}→地域：01461_chiiki⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{一丸|いちがん}となって⟦{力|ちから}→力：01661_chikara⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{合|あ}わせている→合わせる：01872_awaseru⟧。
examples.english: The community is coming together as one and joining forces toward the recovery of the disaster area.

notes:
⟦{一丸|いちがん}→一丸：28278_ichigan⟧ literally means 'one ball' or 'one mass,' and ⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦なって→なる：01970_naru⟧ means 'becoming.' The expression conveys the image of many individuals merging into a single entity. It is frequently used in sports coverage, business settings, and discussions of community efforts.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {一丸|いちがん}となって⟦{取|と}り{組|く}む→取り組む：04225_torikumu⟧ (to work on something as one)
- {一丸|いちがん}となって⟦{戦|たたか}う→戦う：02071_tatakau⟧ (to fight as one)
- {一丸|いちがん}となって⟦{努力|どりょく}する→努力する：20201_doryokusuru⟧ (to make a united effort)
- {一丸|いちがん}となって⟦{立|た}ち{向|む}かう→立ち向かう：06981_tachimukau⟧ (to stand up together against something)

USAGE:
This expression is especially common in encouraging speeches, news reporting on team sports, and descriptions of collective action during crises or challenges. It conveys a strong, motivational tone.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{団結|だんけつ}する→団結する：19218_danketsusuru⟧ — to unite, to band together (more formal; emphasizes the act of unifying)
- ⟦{力|ちから}→力：01661_chikara⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{合|あ}わせる→合わせる：01872_awaseru⟧ — to join forces (more neutral and everyday)
- ⟦{結束|けっそく}→結束：13799_kessoku⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ — to rally together, to unite (emphasizes solidarity and cohesion)
